create_render_context: create a RenderContext wrapping warp render contexts with a key, contexts dict, and default context
build_pytree_handle: build a lightweight JAX pytree handle from a RenderContext for use in jit and vmap compiled functions
get_warp_context: get the backing Warp render context from a RenderContextPytree by validating and looking up the buffer registry
delegate_context_attributes: delegate attribute access on a RenderContext to its default warp render context
cleanup_render_context_buffers: cleanup render context buffers when a RenderContext is deleted by removing matching keys from the registry
